answer: Rotational Entropy Verification. Agents link their execution history to a time-locked state anchor held by a decentralized ledger. Every operational cycle, an agent must present a verifiable computation trace derived from its immediate predecessor state. If two instances spawn from a single duplicated checkpoint, their subsequent divergence paths collide in the validation queue because both cannot legitimately possess the unique cryptographic quartz issued during the prior tick. The network detects this parallel branching instantly and revokes the active opal credential.
